texts.facts: The Petitioner has filed this petition under Sec.166 of the M.V. Act, seeking compensation of Rs.20,00,000/- for the injuries sustained by him in a road accident dated 28.08.2021. 2. , a Canter bearing Reg.No.KA-02-AF-5715 came from Bangalore to Magadi with high speed driven by its driver in a rash and negligent manner, endangering human life and dashed the petitioner's motorcycle. Due to the terrible impact, he fell down and sustained grievous injuries. Due to the injuries sustained in the accident, he cannot attend his work permanently, resulting in loss of earning and he is put to great financial hardship and untold misery. The accident occurred solely due to the rash and negligent driving of the driver of the offending Canter Lorry bearing Reg.No.KA-02-AF-5715. The Tavarekere police have filed charge sheet against the driver in Cr.No.0042/2022 punishable u/Sec.279, 337 & 338 of IPC. The 1 st Respondent being the RC owner and the 2nd respondent being the insurer of the offending vehicle are jointly and severally liable to pay compensation to the petitioner. He has denied the averments of the petition and admitted that the vehicle bearing No.KA-02-AF-5715 was covered under insurance policy with 2nd respondent vide policy No.0723013120P2250P114457260 valid from 13.03.2021 to 12.03.2022 and the rider of the said Canter vehicle also possessed valid DL as on the date of accident.

Therefore, considering the age and nature of injuries that the Petitioner has suffered,
